content: Pinkempitakaantya eerokami irovayirite Jesucristo
Notomí, tema iri neshinonkataami Cristo Jesús, ontzimatye pintontashiretai.
Tema pikemakena tsika okanta niyotaantake atziriiteki. Ontzimatye piyoshiitayete iroñaaka tsika inkarate kyaaryooshireri intzime matanairone iriyotaanairi eejatzi pashine.
Aamaventa pinkantya piñaashitakoventanaiyaari Jesucristo. Pinkempitakaantya eerokami irovayirite.
Tema aparoni ovayiritachari te iñeetziri irantanairo antavairentsi jantayeetapiintaitziri kitaiteriki. Aña ontzimatye iretapaintyaaro ikantakeriri ijevarite.

Kantatsi eejatzi pinkempitakotyaari aparoni ipinayeetziri janaakotantake ishiyeeyani. Tema iniroite iriñaashintsityaaro. Iro kantacha irimatantyaarori iranaakotante ontzimatye irantero tsika okanta jametapiintaiyari. Irooma inkovakemi inthaiyavaitya inkene iranaakotantemi, eerora ipinayeetziri.
Kantatsi eejatzi pinkempitakotyaari ikanta aparoni pankivairentzi. Tema iriitake etapiintaro jovayetaro okitho ivankire.
Ontzimatye pimpampithashiretakotero nokantayetakemiri. Tema iriitake Avinkatharite kemathatakaaperotemirone maaroni.
Pimpampithashiretakoteri Jesucristo itzimi icharinetakari David-ni. Tema añagai irirori ikamavetaka. Irootakera iroka Kameethari Ñaantsi otzimi noñaaventairi.
Irootake nokemaantsitakoventari iroñaaka, okanta noñaantarori joosovaitaitana jashitakoyeetana, ikempitakaantaitakena naakami ovantzinkari. Irooma iñaane Pava eerora imataitziro iroosoyeetakero.

Iro namaveyetantakarori maaroni iroka, okantakaantziro netakotari ikaratzi jiyoshiiyetairi Cristo Jesús itzimi irovavisaakoshiretairi ñaantayetairone kantaitachari añaantarentsi, tema ovaneenka onkantya.
Jiroka omapero ikantayeetziri:

content.text: Aririka ankamakoyetakeri Cristo, ari ankempiyeeyaari irañaakaayetai.
Irooma aririka ankantayete: “Te noñeeri.” Ari inkempitaayetairi eejatzi aakaite.
Iro kantacha terika añaayevetaro ankamaiventyaarimi, irooma irirori ikamaiventayetai. Tema ari jashi jovatziiro irirori, te impashinetanete.

content: Pinkempityaari antavairyaantzi jaakameethaitziri
Piyotaantairo iroka. Pishintsithatantero ikovakaantaperotziri Pava: Eero iñaanatzimentavakaashitaitaro ñaantsiyetatsiri kaari irooperotatsine. Aña kantatsi onkantzimoneentakaiyaari inkarate kemerone.

Ontzimatye piñaashintsitya povatampatzikatanairo ñaantsi kyaaryoori, inkene iraakameethaventaimiro Pava. Pinkempitakotyaari ikantaranki aparoni antavairyaantzi kaari tzimatsine ompaitya impashiventakotyaari.
Povashaantairo eeroka jiñaanetashiyeetari kaariperori. Arira opoñaari ithainkatasorentsitantayeetzi.
Okempitakotaro okantaranki ovavathatanta ampathaavaite. Irootake avishimotakeriri Himeneo ipoña Fileto.

Ikenakaashivaitanakaro irirori jiyotaantziro kyaaryoori, ikantake: “Tera kyaaryoori añaayetai aririka ankamayetake, aña añaayetzitataikaro joshiyakaaventaitziro ‘añagaantsi.’” Tema okaratzi jiyotaantavetakari jovashaantakaakeri tsika ikaratzi joshireveyetanaa.

Iro kantacha, okempivaitakaro Pava irovatzikatyeemi irooperori itzinkami, ari irovetsikakemi ipanko. Ipoña jontarekakotake apite osankinatachari kantatsiri: “Jiyoyetziri Avinkatharite ikaratzi jashiyetari.” Impoña: “Inkarate pairyaagairine Cristo, ontzimatye irovashaantairo kaariperotatsiri.”

Iro kantacha janta iniroiteki ipanko, kempivaitaka tzimayetatsimi ovaneenkatachari kovitzipayeeni, shipakiryaa okantayeta kaminthaa jovayetziro. Tzimayetatsi eejatzi kovitzi jovetsikayeetziro inchato, eejatzi kipatsinaki, kaari ikaminthaaperoitzi.

Aririka ankiteshireyetanai, ari ankempiyetaiyaaro kovitzi ikaminthairo ashitarori, ikovapiintzi irovantayetyaaro. Tasorentsishire inkantakaanai Pava, aamaventa ankantya antayetaineri kameethayetatsiri.

Intaina povayetairo inevetashivaitari evankariite, pinkempitakaantero pishiyapithatatyeeromi. Aña iro pinevetapiintanakya pinkameethashireyetai, oshiretane pinkantya, etakotane povante, kameetha pisaikakaantayete, pinkempiyayetaiyaari kiteshireri itzimi pairyaayetairiri Avinkatharite.
Ontzimatye povashaantayetairo piñaaneyetaro kaari apantyaarone, tema iro opoñaantari ikisavakaantayeetari.
Irooma aakaite jomperatayetai Pava te arite amatero añaanaminthatavakaiya. Aña ontzimatye aneshinonkashiretante, ayimaneenta ayotaantai, tsinampashire ankantya,
shipetashire ankantya ankaminaayeteri kisaneentairi, aama ari impiyashiretakairi Pava, ari iriyotakotairo kyaaryoori.
Ari onkantya inkempitakotantyaariri amathaatari ivirentsi, tema kamaari otzikatakari, ishintsiventziri irantayeteneri ikovakaashiyetari irirori.
